Thank you. Let me share the details you asked for.

1) How to find the booking  
I don’t have the confirmation code handy. The booking would be under:
- Name: Farhan Ahmed Qureshi  
- Email: farhan.qureshi@aurangabadhistory.in  
- Phone: +91-240-555-2184  
- City/address of service: Aurangabad, at my residence  
- Approximate service date: 10 January 2026 (or very close to that; it was just before a small departmental gathering at my home)

2) Service and issue details  
The service was for a full house cleaning. The main issues were:
- Partial work not completed: one bedroom and the balcony were barely touched, despite being included in the booking. Dusting on higher shelves and corners in the living room was also left unfinished.
- Damage: one of my wooden bookshelves was damaged. Specifically, the bottom edge and one side panel have new scratches/gouges, and the laminate has chipped off in a small section. This is in the living room where I keep reference books for my students.

I did mention the bookshelf damage to the cleaner before they left. They apologized verbally but said I should contact support through the app/website for any refund or compensation. I have not yet raised a formal ticket; I am approaching you directly now.

3) Refund amount  
I don’t recall the exact total amount, but it was the standard full-house cleaning rate for my flat. I am not asking for a full refund, only a partial one. Given that a significant part of the work was not done properly and there is damage to the bookshelf, I think something in the range of 30–40% of the booking amount as a partial refund would be fair.

If you need me to choose a specific figure, I would say 35% of the booking amount as a partial refund.
